text_block_list.text:
Симболи Рудольф has been training harder
than
ever in the run-up to the spring
Tenno Sho,
adjusting her focus to
account for the unique
demands of the
race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But now that she's a senior and making a
name for
herself in the racing world, the
demands on her
time are multiplying.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
So, to wrap things up, could you tell us
what your
plans are for the future?
text_block_list.name: Репортёр

text_block_list.text:
I mean to recommit myself to training,
with the
goal of becoming the Emperor
of all Umamusume.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I hope that you continue to cover every
step of
my imperial campaign.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I promise to exceed all of your
expectations.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
You sound as confident as ever! I'll be
rooting for
you!
text_block_list.name: Репортёр

text_block_list.text: Thank you very much.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Next is my TV interview, I believe...
Hmmm. My
schedule's been packed a
little too tight,
perhaps...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
As a rising star, Симболи Рудольф is
constantly
swamped with interviews.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She takes it all in stride, saying that it's
proof of
the stir she's causing in the
racing world, but I'm a
bit more
worried...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Shall we head to the track? This
interview
presents a golden opportunity
for the academy.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Perfect for the announcement I have
planned.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Haha. You can cock your head at me all
you like,
but I'm not telling. You'll just
have to wait and
see.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
And that concludes our tour of the
academy.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
We host guided visits periodically, so
please
apply if you're interested.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
That's fascinating... but is there any
other way to
get a feel for the academy
aside from guided
tours?
text_block_list.name: TV Репортёр

text_block_list.text:
Indeed there is—and what's more, it will
be held
in only a few days' time.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: How interesting! Can you tell us more?
text_block_list.name: TV Репортёр

text_block_list.text: It's called the Fan Fest.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Every spring, Академия Тайсен hosts a
large event
complete with races and
more. It's intended to
help our students
interact with the fans who
support them.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
This year, we plan to expand its scope
and create
our first "Mega" Fan Fest.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
You don't say! How are you going to
make it
bigger?
text_block_list.name: TV Репортёр

text_block_list.text:
We plan to offer additional races,
volunteer
presentations, live panels with
academy
graduates...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
And a wide variety of other new
activities for
visitors to enjoy.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
It will be accessible for both racing fans
and
newcomers alike.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
That sounds marvelous! Do you have any
plans to
take part in the event yourself?
text_block_list.name: TV Репортёр

text_block_list.text:
I will spend most of the Fan Fest
patrolling the
grounds in my capacity as
student council
president...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
But to close out the day, I will take part
in the
main attraction: the exhibition
race.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
choice_data_list: (Huh?! She never told me about that!)

text_block_list.text:
Holy moly! So we'll get to see you race
in person?
How incredibly exciting!
text_block_list.name: TV Репортёр

text_block_list.text:
You hear that, everyone? Make sure to
check out
Tracen Academy's Fan Fest!
text_block_list.name: TV Репортёр

text_block_list.text:
You're guaranteed to have a fan-fest-ic
time.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Be sure not to miss this opportunity to
watch our
very own Umamusume
compete live on the track.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Phew. That's the last of them for today.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
choice_data_list: What's this about the exhibition race?

text_block_list.text:
I've been planning it for a while, but I
only
received the official approval a few
days ago.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
As the name implies, I hope to make it
the Fan
Fest's main attraction.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Accordingly, I have scheduled it as the
finale of
the event, and gathered all of
the school's best
racers to take part.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
The Emperor's presence on the track will
only
raise its profile further.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
If I can personally contribute to the Fan
Fest's
success, then so much the better.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
choice_data_list: You should have told me sooner.

text_block_list.text:
Exhibition or not, a race is a race. I
would have
appreciated the opportunity
to adjust her
training regimen so that she
could give her best
performance, and I
tell her as much.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I appreciate the sentiment, but I've
already
factored in our current schedule.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: No adjustments will be required.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
But that will still place a heavy burden
on her. As
her trainer, it's something I
can't ignore.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: You need to rely on me more.

text_block_list.text:
I appreciate your concern, Trainer. Truly,
I do.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
But by the same token, I ask the same
from you.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Please, have a little more faith in me.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
No... Perhaps that's the wrong way of
thinking
about it.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
If I were truly worth believing in, I
wouldn't have
to convince you at all.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
That, I believe, is what Эйр Грув was
trying to
tell me.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
You've got it all wrong, President. You
don't...
understand at all...
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I must be more selfless. Push myself
harder. Make
greater sacrifices.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Who will follow the Emperor if she
doesn't show
that she can lead?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
My ideal is still a distant dream. I must
seek out
more victories and greater
prestige.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
From the way she's speaking, she should
sound
grand, but instead she just looks...
like she's
drowning.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: Have you spoken with Эйр Грув?

text_block_list.text:
Not yet. Preparing for the Fan Fest has
been
keeping her too busy.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Besides, she has already thrown down
the
gauntlet, and I've found my answer
to it.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I will put on such a convincing
performance at the
exhibition race that
none will be able to doubt
me.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Failure is a luxury I can't afford on such a
grand
stage.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
A mediocre performance will undermine
the
impact I've made on the racing
world, and I
cannot allow that.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Every word lands like another weight on
her back.
It almost hurts to watch...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
There you are, President! There are a
few things I
wanted to confirm with you
about the Fan Fest...
text_block_list.name: Student Council Member

text_block_list.text: Of course. I'll be right there.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: My apologies, Trainer, but duty calls.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
She departs, leaving me wondering once
more if
there's anything I can do to help
her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
